meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 在报告 UI 完成前会先截取每个页面、状态、视口的截图,跑脚本量出差异比例、溢出与边框对齐等数据,再并行派两个只读评审复核,最后给出通过或返修的结论。
howto.when: 构建或改动任何 UI 后、宣称完成前触发,也适用于你问某页面、组件或 TUI 看起来对不对;纯后端、没有渲染画面的逻辑不适用。

say.text: 帮我对比这个页面和设计稿,出通过或返修结论
say.note: 会先截图,再派两个评审复核

say.text: 给这个终端界面做视觉验收,按 80 列检查
say.note: 会渲染真实终端并检查溢出

say.text: 这个组件改完看着对吗?跑一次视觉 QA
say.note: 会重新截图,不用旧证据

howto.what_en: Before calling a UI done, Claude captures screenshots of every page, state, and viewport, runs scripts for diff ratio, overflow, and border alignment, dispatches two read-only reviewer passes, then returns a pass or revise verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build or change and before claiming it done, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Not for backend logic with no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Compare this page against the mock and give a pass or revise verdict
Run visual QA on this terminal UI at 80 columns
say_en.note: Renders a real terminal, checks overflow

say_en.text: I changed this component — does it look right? Run visual QA
